title: API endpoint returns 500 on every request
description: GET /status proxies to aicoe-lab-error-function. Because that function raises (see issue 003), the HTTP API returns 500 Internal Server Error on 100% of requests. Verified live; an unrouted path on the same API still returns 404, so the failure is the integration, not routing.

detection.primary: HTTP GET the endpoint -> 500 with body {"message":"Internal Server Error"}
detection.metric: AWS/ApiGateway 5xx count equals request count for ApiId 1t6mt8jl5k
detection.correlation: API 5xx lines up with Errors on aicoe-lab-error-function and its CloudWatch log entries
detection.signal: elevated 5xx error rate traced to a failing integration target

remediation.description: Fixing the error function's configuration makes the route return 200.
